pay.qrAlt: UPI QR code of the Sabha

proof.title: Upload payment proof
proof.screenshotHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB
proof.utrHint: 12 to 22 letters or digits, shown in your UPI app after payment
proof.note2: The Treasurer checks it against the bank statement, usually within 2 working days.
proof.errUtr: UTR must be 12 to 22 letters or digits, without spaces.
proof.errFuture: The payment date cannot be in the future.
proof.successBody: Thank you! We have received your payment details. You will get a notification and a receipt once the Treasurer approves it.
proof.headOnlyTitle: Only the head of the family can submit payments
proof.headOnlyBody: Please ask the head of your family to upload the payment proof.

my.title: My payments
my.subtitle: Everything you have submitted and its status
my.emptyBody: When you pay and upload proof, it will be listed here.

desk.subtitle: Check each screenshot against the Sabha bank statement, then approve or reject.
desk.search: Search member, membership no. or UTR
desk.emptyPendingBody: There are no payments waiting for verification.
desk.remarks: Remarks (shown to the member if rejected)
